title: 3BR - Sleeps 10 | Makeup Room + Rooftop!
description:
Girls getaway Stylish Three-Bedroom Townhome Retreat Near Downtown Nashville

Escape to a chic and comfortable three-bedroom apartment just 8 minutes from the vibrant heart of downtown Nashville. Perfect for travelers seeking adventure and relaxation alike, this modern getaway offers thoughtfully curated amenities and a tranquil atmosphere to ensure a memorable stay.

The space
The modern and comfy getaway will leave you in awe with its carefully picked amenity list. 

★ LIVING ROOM ★

It is ideal for relaxing and enjoying the company of friends and family while watching a good movie or a show. 
✔ Comfortable Sofas with Pillows 
✔ Flat-Screen TV 
✔ Coffee Table 
✔ Sofa

★ KITCHEN ★ 

The modern kitchen area with numerous cooking appliances and spacious countertops is at the top of the stairs. If you want to take a break from the restaurants, then this is the place for you. 
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/Freezer 
✔ Dishwasher 
✔ Toaster 
✔ Blender
✔ Sink - Hot & Cold Water 
✔ Trays 
✔ Glasses 
✔ Silverware 
✔ Pots & Pans
★ ENTERTAINMENT ROOM ★
While Broadway’s bars are just minutes away, this home comes with its very own entertainment room. Shake up a cocktail, pop the champagne, and let the music play—this space is made for late-night conversations, dancing, and unforgettable memories. And yes, it’s pink—because as the saying goes: til dark blues turn to dusty pinks!
★ MAKE-UP ROOM ★
Get ready in style with a full make-up room designed for your whole crew. Glam it up together before hitting the town—because in this house, Nashville looks good on you!
★ ROOFTOP ★
Start your morning with breakfast under the sky, share dinner with friends, or simply take in the sparkling Nashville skyline. Whether day or night, the rooftop is the perfect spot to relax, connect, and create lasting memories.

★ 3 BEDROOMS ★
The bedrooms feature a comfortable bed designed to provide you with the perfect resting experience. 

Master Bedroom 1:
✔ King–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2) 
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

Bedroom 2:
✔ (2) Queen–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (Sleeps 2)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

Bedroom 3:
✔ (2) Full–Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - sleeps 4)
✔ Wardrobe with Hangers and Shelves 

2nd Floor Hallway:
✔ (2)Twin-Size Bed with Pillows, Linens, and Sheets (1 Bunkbed - sleeps 2)

★ 4 BATHROOMS ★ 
The apartment features a spacious full bathroom stocked with all necessities and essential toiletries, so you don’t need to bring your own. 
✔ Mirrors 
✔ Toilet 
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential Toiletries

Guest access
The apartment is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with: 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Ceiling Fan 
✔ Washer/Dryer (in the unit)
